scope.purpose: Only original supplier acceptance, selected project/native/standard facet reception, exact before/after preservation, and the separately requested effective memory capacity gate.

current_draft_safety.consequence: The frozen draft aborts before filesystem creation, source fetch, or Lean. Findings are final-readiness requirements, not an assertion that unqualified proof was accepted or that existing mathematics failed.

confirmed_static_properties.finding: The exact pinned b7e2341 projection selects 58 old project modules. Existing P3 inputs are reduced by original headers to FibreCore plus the two explicit Mathlib roots. Combined project sources/objects equal the projection, and the target has no preexisting accepted object. The unused P3 Power object is not admitted by the original 18-module superset.

The exact original ROOT_ACCEPTANCE blob 36b6d39a at commit 952caa6e is checked by schema/status/module/source/object and validation/graph/manifest hashes. Original manifest members bind validation, source-and-output records, and actual graph; the original archive index and object identity are also checked. Validation normal/kernel/owned exits, 17 owned declarations, standard axioms, and original warnings policy are parsed. This is stronger than accepting only a root status or module count.

Original module and facet keys are unique; header reachability equals the admitted roots. The normalized module/facet key sets exactly equal the original. Each relocation is unique and matches the original identity verbatim while preserving bytes and SHA; all original facets are covered. Original header contents and authority/provider records are carried into the normalized bindings.

Overlapping project source/object metadata and module headers must agree. Each overlapping native or standard (module, facet) must have the identical chosen current path, byte count, SHA, and stat. A canonical complete module/facet/identity map hash supplements the counts. Same source with a different object is not accepted as equal.

Before normal, the actual resolved import facet identity map must equal the entire prepared authority map. Every actual old facet must be in the admitted map and match its exact identity/stat, including module headers; a fallback standard-path classification cannot bypass this membership check. After normal, all old identities remain exactly equal, and only the new target .olean import facet is added. The expected project closure changes from 58 to 59.

New target source is the only permitted normal source call; old source/kernel/owned replays remain zero. Original runtime/guard/parser pins and 14 V1 helper ASTs are unchanged. The new target follows normal, current imports, named kernel, full owned audit, and final checks. This is static inspection only; the combined runtime probe has not been claimed to pass.

required_final_ready_changes.finding: Affine qualification pointers are selected by the final contract and currently checked only for their returned value. A role named for a module does not require that its exit/count pointer belong to that module's original normal/kernel/owned record. The normal records file is SHA-pinned, but the checked original root/qualification field chain does not yet require an original accepted manifest/record to identify that file hash.
required_final_ready_changes.concrete_boundary_example: Both module kernel_exit and owned_exit bindings could select the same unrelated aggregate zero in the qualification receipt. The role names and value comparison would pass without proving that either zero is the selected module's stage result. This example is about the generic schema boundary; no allegation is made about pending actual Affine records.
required_final_ready_changes.minimum_fix: After the real Affine schema is available, bind its schema/status and exact selected modules/roots. Select each original per-module record by a verified module key/field, then read its source/object and normal exit together; bind kernel requested/replayed roots and exit, and owned requested modules/inventory count map and exit, within their corresponding original process records. Also anchor the exact normal-records file hash to the original accepted manifest/root/qualification record, or to an explicit independent root acceptance of that original file. Concrete fixed pointers are acceptable if these record-identity relationships are separately checked. Do not add old proof replays.

required_final_ready_changes.origin: Parent independently identified this; the author acknowledged the same narrow issue. This reviewer confirmed the current code and the existing local system-info fields only.
required_final_ready_changes.finding: Current runtime memory gate compares only host /proc/meminfo MemAvailable. It does not bind the selected MCP run_command memory_mb limit or the actual cgroup limit/current, which can be smaller.
required_final_ready_changes.minimum_fix: Preserve the early pre-mkdir gate. Bind this exact task's explicit MCP memory_mb budget, observe the applicable cgroup v2/v1 limit and current usage, and retain the host measurement. Require the needed available budget against the effective minimum of applicable host, cgroup, and task remaining allowances, with exact sampling/enforcement evidence. An unavailable required budget must not silently become the host value. Keep the output budget and /workspace destination checks.
